subtitulo: Ha debido de salir. Debe de haber llovido.
regla: To guess what must have happened: ha debido (de) + infinitive, or debe (de) + haber + participle: Debe de haber llovido. The de is optional for assumptions. A fact usually backs up the guess.

bloques.texto: To make an **assumption about the past** with **deber**, you have two patterns:

lista.texto: **Ha debido de llamar a la policía.**
**Debe de haber llamado a la policía.**

bloques.texto: For assumptions, **de** is optional. Without context, **debe + haber** can also sound like obligation, so **de** makes the guess clearer.
A fact usually backs up the guess: **ha debido de ser buena maestra; sus alumnos le trajeron flores**.
Pronouns: in front of the whole phrase or attached to the infinitive: **se ha debido retrasar** / **ha debido retrasarse** / **debe haberse retrasado**.
Tip: there's evidence, and **deber** draws the conclusion.

lista.es: Manuela ==ha debido llamar== a la policía.
lista.en: Manuela must have called the police.

lista.es: Todavía no llegan; su vuelo ==ha debido retrasarse==.
lista.en: They still haven't arrived; their flight must have been delayed.

lista.es: Sara ==ha debido de dejar== a su hijo en la guardería en la mañana.
lista.en: Sara must have dropped her son off at daycare this morning.

lista.es: Cristina ==ha debido de ser== buena maestra; sus alumnos le compraron flores.
lista.en: Cristina must have been a good teacher; her students bought her flowers.

lista.es: Manuela ==debe haber llamado== a la policía.
lista.en: Manuela must have called the police.

lista.es: ==Debe de haber llovido== en la noche, porque los carros están mojados.
lista.en: It must have rained last night, because the cars are wet.

lista.texto: Another way to guess: [[7266|future perfect for the past]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.r: Ha debido de olvidarse. / Debe de haberse olvidado.

lista.p: In Spanish: _It must have been expensive._
